annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Communication from the Commission: Quality Jobs Roadmap (COM(2025) 944 final)
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee on the Communication from the Commission: Quality Jobs Roadmap (COM(2025) 944 final)
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion welcoming the Commission's Quality Jobs Roadmap. It stresses social dialogue, workplace health and safety, lifelong learning and enforcement of existing law. It briefly addresses AI and algorithmic management, calling for safeguards under the GDPR and AI Act and possible EU instruments. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Promote shared job-quality indicators drawing on OECD, ILO and Eurofound work
Place social dialogue and collective bargaining at the centre of any initiative
Make health and safety a pillar of job quality, covering psychosocial and digital risks
Ensure AI in the workplace has safeguards against surveillance, work intensification and deskilling
Assess whether EU instruments are needed on algorithmic management, the right to disconnect and related areas
